app.name: ScummVM (timer fix test RPX)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.long_description: Candidate fix, not yet confirmed on hardware. Restores the immediate return for zero-timeout SDL semaphore waits. Audio timer and SCI resource diagnostics retained. Read TESTING.md, back up saves and config. Non-Aroma RPX unverified. No games or MT-32 ROMs included.
